{'test_behavior': 'Verify that the LocationPath method correctly throws a ParseException when given an invalid input like "invalid".\nIn the original JXPath grammar, a bare identifier is not a valid start for a LocationPath, \nbut it is a valid token. The parser will attempt to parse it as a path.\n    // If it cannot complete the path or identify it as an absolute path, it should fail.\n    // We use a StringReader with a single identifier which is not a valid LocationPath.\n    XPathParser parser = new XPathParser(new java.io.StringReader("invalid"));\n    parser.setCompiler(new MockCompiler());\n    parser.LocationPath();\n}\n', 'new_imports_code': ''}
